sub_answers.text: The Makonde of northern Mozambique are particularly renowned for wood sculpture as a major art form [d19304s6p0]. The Makonde are also associated with dance as a prominent cultural expression [d19304s6p0]. Makonde communities in the region occupied parts of the Mueda Plateau in northern Mozambique [d74678494s11p0]. The broader population in Mozambique has largely retained an indigenous culture based on small-scale agriculture, which applies to groups including the Makonde [d19304s6p0].

sub_answers.text: Portuguese colonial campaigns used extended military expeditions and networks of posts to pacify and incorporate northern Mozambican territories where Makonde and other tribes lived, directly imposing colonial control on local polities and leaders [d74678494s11p0]. Portugal and chartered companies employed large numbers of African soldiers, sipaios, and allied native warriors in occupation efforts, which shifted military and political power relations within local societies [d74678494s11p0]. Anti-colonial nationalist mobilization by migrant workers and students coalesced into organizations (UDENAMO) that later merged into broader liberation movements, providing a channel for political mobilization that reshaped regional politics during decolonization [d2129607s0p0].
